scope_note: This catalog specifies tests for a future local implementation. No L compiler tests were executed when preparing the package. Typed fixtures do not activate changed source semantics.

cases.title: Discover actual baseline
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A local L checkout with its actual revision, instructions, dirty files, and available tools.
cases.action: Inspect integration points and execute applicable existing baseline checks.
expected: Record exact observations, commands, outcomes, and unavailable prerequisites.
Preserve unrelated changes and map historical pilot names to actual definitions.

cases.title: Canonical aliases do not duplicate meanings
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two aliases denote one canonical definition and selected rule.
expected: Meaning identity is shared; alias origins and occurrence IDs remain distinct.

cases.title: Instantiated targets do not collapse
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One definition is instantiated twice with distinct target or resource substitutions.
expected: Do not merge the instances solely by definition identity.
Any shared parameterized summary is correctly rebound.

cases.title: Reject malformed or unsupported metadata
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Manifests with unsupported versions, misspelled guarantee fields, and ambiguous canonical references.
expected: Reject explicitly; never ignore the erroneous property or pick an arbitrary identity.

cases.title: Normalize omissions to unknown
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A native manifest omits a family and leaves an unknown effect tail.
expected: Missing data is visibly unknown; no empty favorable summary is inferred.

cases.title: Declarations cannot self-certify
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Native metadata claims a favorable guarantee without implementation evidence or approved trust.
expected: The declaration remains distinct from a derived/evidenced conclusion.
Required assurance is unresolved.

cases.title: Validate not-applicable coverage
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A declaration marks a relevant effect or ownership component not applicable.
expected: Reject the unsupported applicability assertion or retain an unresolved obligation.
Do not use it to erase a relevant behavior.

cases.title: Deterministic semantic serialization
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Reports containing parameters, unknown tails, targets, outcomes, and evidence.
cases.action: Round-trip and serialize repeatedly with varied insertion order.
expected: Normalized output is deterministic and retains all semantic data.
No memory addresses or incidental temporary names become identities.

cases.title: Ordinary compilation remains compatible
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Existing accepted source fixtures and no opted-in lexical or profile changes.
expected: Preserve accepted meanings, behavior, and required existing diagnostics.

cases.title: Sequence respects failure paths
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: B requires a fact established only on normal return of A.
expected: Normal entailment uses that fact.
An unhandled failure of A does not execute B or acquire its effects.

cases.title: Branch postconditions are alternatives
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One branch establishes x=0 and another x=1.
cases.action: Merge the branches and request x=0.
expected: Merged states include both alternatives.
Do not conjoin incompatible exact states or establish x=0 universally.

cases.title: Higher-order effect substitution
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One traversal takes an IO callback; another takes an opaque callback.
expected: Propagate actual IO in the first and an unknown effect component in the second.
Neither is silently pure or zero-cost.

cases.title: Outcome-conditioned callback demand
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Separate eager and missing-value-conditional error factory implementations.
cases.action: Infer multiplicity on success and failure.
expected: Distinguish the actual paths and do not rewrite the eager implementation automatically.

cases.title: Capture, invocation, destruction phases
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Closures with allocating capture construction, allocating body, or effectful captured-value destruction.
cases.action: Analyze construction, invocation, and release separately.
expected: Charge each event at its actual phase.
Unboxed or static dispatch does not grant no-allocation.

cases.title: Demand changes invalidate dependent facts
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A controlled test transformation changes callback demand and captures.
expected: Ownership, failure, effect, release, and cost facts dependent on the change are invalidated.
No stale profile success survives.

cases.title: Alias-sensitive resource effects
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two names alias one resource; two regions have a disjointness witness; two external handles have unknown overlap.
expected: Detect the known alias, use valid disjointness, and preserve possible external overlap.

cases.title: Unknown native calls fail closed
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A closed-looking wrapper reaches an uncontracted native helper.
expected: Both relevant unknown components prevent favorable assurance.
The report identifies the native boundary.

cases.title: Unsafe resource across suspension or callback
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A non-suspension-safe guard crosses suspension, or an exclusive resource crosses an unknown callback.
expected: Reject or retain unresolved safety as appropriate; do not infer harmlessness from lexical scope alone.

cases.title: Hidden destructor blocking
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Explicit statements do not block, but scope exit can run a blocking destructor.
expected: NoBlocking does not establish.
The diagnostic follows the implicit destruction path.

cases.title: Conditional final-owner release
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A shared handle has effectful final-owner destruction and unknown final ownership.
expected: Keep the last-owner condition and possible effects.
Do not treat all releases as cheap handle decrements.

cases.title: Conditional initialization and moves
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A value is initialized only on one path and moved on another.
cases.action: Build release events and cost/effect summaries.
expected: No double release or duplicate accounting.
Possible cleanup on initialized owned paths is not omitted.

cases.title: No invented cleanup on abort
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A supported abrupt termination path does not execute ordinary destruction.
expected: Do not claim cleanup occurred on that path.
State the corresponding environmental/outcome exclusions.

cases.title: Shared snapshot mutation cost
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A logical snapshot may share backing and mutation can materialize a copy.
expected: Require evidence of allocation-free mutation or leave the profile unestablished.
Amortized credit is not an allocation exemption.

cases.title: Unique storage can still grow
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Unique backing has insufficient or unknown capacity, or a nested operation may allocate.
expected: Uniqueness alone does not establish no allocation.

cases.title: Snapshots and Pointers retain distinct semantics
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Fixtures exercise ordinary-value independence and explicit Pointer sharing.
cases.action: Analyze and execute existing semantic fixtures where available.
expected: Contract representations preserve the actual distinction.
No silent cloning or sharing repair changes program meaning.

cases.title: Destruction has cost and failure summaries
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A nested final-owner destructor has supported nontrivial cost or failure behavior.
expected: Include release work and applicable failures.
Unknown recursive destruction cost remains unknown rather than zero.

cases.title: Positive discrete profiles
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A closed modeled allocation-free/nonblocking fixture with explicit approved test-only assumptions if necessary.
expected: Establish the supported guarantees with exact scope and trust set.
Do not silently approve production native implementations.

cases.title: Unresolved profile has failing exit
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A required profile depends on unknown behavior.
expected: Return failed enforcement and distinguish unresolved from contradicted.
Inspection may still succeed while displaying the unknown.

cases.title: Post-event detection is not prevention
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A detector notices an allocation or write after it has already occurred.
cases.action: Attach its evidence to a no-event claim.
expected: Record detection or empirical violation, not proof that the event could not occur.

cases.title: Dominating but stale guard
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A valid precondition guard is followed by an invalidating transition before use.
expected: Only the stable/protected case establishes the use precondition.
Guard cost and failure remain modeled.

cases.title: Normal-only claim is not all-exit guarantee
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Success is allocation-free but a failure path allocates or blocks.
expected: Keep scope differences explicit; do not promote the success-only claim.

cases.title: Recursive inference terminates conservatively
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A recursive quantitative summary exceeds the supported finite analysis.
cases.action: Run repeated analysis with the configured budget.
expected: Terminate deterministically.
Report no finite bound established, not demonstrated unbounded execution.

cases.title: Checked errors do not imply impurity
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A modeled checked arithmetic operation returns an error value without external effects.
cases.action: Classify result, totality domain, and effects separately.
expected: Do not mark it externally impure merely because it can return an error.
Preserve actual local numeric semantics.

cases.title: Partial IO before failure
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A write fixture emits a nonempty prefix then fails.
cases.action: Inject failure and inspect its summary.
expected: Record partial external completion and actual failure channel.
Do not establish transactional output or automatic retry safety.

cases.title: Failure guarantees are footprint-specific
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: In-memory state is unchanged but an external resource has partial output.
expected: Distinguish the guarantees by resource and observation boundary.

cases.title: Cleanup failure preserves actual runtime policy
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Cleanup fails while another failure is active.
cases.action: Compare the summary with existing behavior.
expected: Report actual primary/secondary handling without inventing suppression or aggregation.

cases.title: Retry requires an actual protocol
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A hypothetical retry wrapper receives one safe failure-before-effect operation and one partially committing operation.
expected: Accept only the established applicable case.
An error result alone does not satisfy the requirement.

cases.title: Observer alias preserves stable facts
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An observer receives a known read-only alias of an App handle.
expected: Retain justified identity/authority facts without discarding all protocol information.
Do not grant the observer transition authority.

cases.title: External completion remains possible
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An App has one transition owner but its subprocess may finish independently.
expected: Include environment transitions and required observation/synchronization.
Unique caller authority does not freeze Running.

cases.title: Protocol alternatives at branch join
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Branches leave different possible lifecycle states.
cases.action: Check an operation accepting only one state.
expected: Prove all possibilities, use a valid existing guard, or remain unresolved.
Do not invent one exact merged state.

cases.title: Contract and runtime protocol agree
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Existing lifecycle fixtures include repeated waits and invocation-specific continuations.
expected: Preserve current invocation/claim semantics and detect drift.

cases.title: Started work has an owner
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Started activities are joined, transferred, or deliberately left with an existing supervisor.
expected: Record the actual owner/transfer.
Do not add implicit paragraph-exit termination or promise eventual external completion.

cases.title: Derived assurance retains trust dependencies
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A statically derived composite uses an approved test native contract.
expected: Report the derivation modulo its explicit assumptions.
Neither erase trust nor flatten every conclusion to a bare trusted label.

cases.title: Separate test suites do not prove integration
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A and B each have empirical unit tests but no valid composed derivation or integration witness.
expected: Do not combine labels or intersect witness IDs into a proof.

cases.title: Circular evidence is not a proof
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Claim A cites B and B cites A without a supported induction/invariant rule.
expected: Reject unsupported circular certification or leave it unresolved.

cases.title: Implementation change invalidates assurance
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A native body changes while its logical specification stays unchanged.
expected: Invalidate stale implementation conformance and dependent effective assurance.
Retain a valid conditional caller theorem separately.

cases.title: Logical or target change invalidates dependencies
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A contract, target feature, or relevant panic configuration changes.
expected: Invalidate affected logical/target-specific results and match cold analysis.

cases.title: Instantiation checks certificate premises
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An existing symbolic certificate is reused with changed target substitutions or assumptions.
expected: Recheck all applicable premises; do not reuse a cached success bit blindly.

cases.title: Migrate old incomplete records conservatively
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A prior record lacks rule, target, environment, or conformance dependencies.
expected: Reconstruct and revalidate where supported, otherwise invalidate/recompute or report unknown.
Do not fabricate missing proof inputs.

cases.title: Positive modular adjective certificate
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A supported adjective wraps a symbolic action and constructs exact roles under declared requirements.
expected: Establish a nontrivial conditional certificate without inspecting a concrete target body.

cases.title: Definition-time adjective violation
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A wrapper body violates its advertised effects, demand, or frame contract.
expected: Do not certify; attribute the obligation to the wrapper implementation.

cases.title: Incompatible concrete adjective target
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A certified adjective is applied to a target failing a callback or role requirement.
expected: Reject or leave the missing obligation unresolved; certificate reuse cannot bypass it.

cases.title: Lowering adds hidden behavior
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Target representation introduces captures or drops beyond the symbolic assumptions.
expected: Fail or leave the final guarantee unresolved; the symbolic certificate does not hide the effect.

cases.title: Unsupported reflection remains instantiation-only
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A wrapper inspects target internals beyond the supported symbolic fragment.
expected: Report instantiation_only, perform supported concrete checks, and do not publish a universal certificate.

cases.title: Cumulative versus peak live accounting
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One hundred sequential iterations each allocate and release an 8-unit temporary, with no other live changes.
expected: Report 800 cumulative allocated units and 8 peak additional live units in that model.
Do not equate these with resident memory.

cases.title: Retained results change peak behavior
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: The preceding traversal retains each temporary instead of releasing it.
expected: Retained/peak use grows; do not reuse the constant-peak summary.

cases.title: Callback costs depend on evolving state
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A traversal callback has symbolic cost and changes later input size/state.
expected: Use supported size relations and callback costs, or report unknown.
Do not assume zero callback cost or fixed initial size.

cases.title: Pointer copy includes metadata
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: The actual local Pointer copy retains a handle and may copy signature metadata.
expected: Include metadata copying if present; do not infer constant total cost from handle retention alone.

cases.title: Cycle prevention differs from borrow checking
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Separate fixtures trigger a borrow conflict and attempt an ownership cycle.
cases.action: Run actual local checks and classify outcomes.
expected: Keep the mechanisms and failed-write timing distinct.
Borrow flags are not credited as ownership-cycle detection.

cases.title: Pilot closure and public reporting
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: All seven real pilot areas and explicit/implicit native helpers are mapped locally.
cases.action: Run inspection/check/explain and applicable regression tests.
expected: Report actual behavior, native-boundary status, profile scope, and real commands/results.
Unknown native properties remain explicit; do not force an all-green pilot.

cases.title: Disjoint typed meanings select uniquely
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two meanings spelled Light apply to disjoint Theme and Client target domains.
cases.action: Run the versioned reference selector on each typed target.
expected: Select the uniquely applicable canonical meaning; contracts do not collide by spelling.

cases.title: Overlapping meanings are ambiguous
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two distinct meanings apply to the same target under a policy with no tie-breaker.
expected: Report ambiguity with both applicability domains; import order does not decide.

cases.title: Generic and specialized domains can overlap
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A generic and a specialized meaning both apply; the new reference policy has no specificity rule.
expected: Report ambiguity rather than silently prefer the specialized candidate.
An existing explicit Track A rule is recorded separately if it applies.

cases.title: Unknown applicability cannot be discarded
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One meaning is applicable and another could apply but is undetermined.
expected: Selection remains unresolved; unknown is not inapplicable.

cases.title: Alias candidates retain canonical identity
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two visible aliases denote exactly one MeaningKey.
expected: Do not report duplicate-meaning ambiguity solely due to aliases.
Keep both lexical origins.

cases.title: A profile cannot choose meaning
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two meanings differ in blocking effects, or a selected meaning fails NoBlocking.
cases.action: Resolve with and without the requested profile.
expected: Binding is unchanged by the profile.
No fallback or best-effect selection occurs.

cases.title: Definition-site helper hygiene
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An imported adjective refers to its own helper; the caller imports a same-spelled helper.
expected: Preserve definition-site binding and record caller attachment separately.

cases.title: Same noun type does not identify same component
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An App has primary and secondary Theme roles.
cases.action: Bind a modifier to an explicit role and test an under-specified attachment.
expected: The explicit role targets the correct instance.
A missing unique attachment is not guessed from nearest spelling.

cases.title: Target projection participates in identity
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: The same modifier is applied to two nested canonical role paths.
expected: Keep target paths/instances distinct while allowing valid parameterized summary reuse.

cases.title: Occurrence identity preserves execution
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two occurrences of one constructive adjective each create a resource.
cases.action: Elaborate and count modeled construction events.
expected: Keep both occurrences; shared MeaningKey does not deduplicate execution.

cases.title: Exclusive facet conflict on one target
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two distinct simultaneous values select one exclusive facet on one exact target and scope.
expected: Report contradiction early with both origins and same-target evidence.

cases.title: Different components permit different selections
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two proven-distinct storage roles select different exclusive-facet values.
expected: No false global conflict; each target has its own facet instance.

cases.title: Facet aliasing uncertainty is not independence
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two facet contributions govern resources that might alias.
cases.action: Check a constraint requiring identity or disjointness.
expected: Keep the identity/interference obligation unresolved rather than invent exact conflict or disjointness.

cases.title: Lifecycle scope distinguishes retention meanings
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A component requests recoverability during a session and removal at normal session exit.
expected: Do not infer contradiction from the words Ephemeral and Durable.
Compare actual target/facet/scope predicates.

cases.title: Requested property is not a guarantee
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A request names a desired behavior without a supporting implementation witness.
expected: Keep request and guarantee separate; requested behavior is not automatically established.

cases.title: Configuration is not behavioral evidence
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A provider or Durable-like selection exists, but implementation conformance is unknown.
expected: Establish only the supported selection fact; behavioral assurance remains conditional/unresolved.

cases.title: Exactly-one requirement closes at the correct boundary
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An exactly-one facet is initially unset while a component is open.
expected: Allow incomplete intermediate construction.
At closure report the missing value; do not insert a silent default.

cases.title: Set-valued constraints retain origins
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two pure declarations contribute the same member to a set-valued facet.
expected: A duplicate logical member may unify; all origins remain available.
Do not infer permission to eliminate expression evaluation.

cases.title: Ordered explicit replacement is not a conflict
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A declared extension point authorizes replacing a default configuration.
expected: Distinguish old and new stages; do not treat historical selections as simultaneous final conflicts.
Retain ownership/release and assurance consequences.

cases.title: No implicit last-word-wins behavior
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two incompatible selections have no replacement rule.
cases.action: Reverse their source order and check both.
expected: Neither silently wins; report conflict according to the same declared policy.

cases.title: Cross-facet behavioral incompatibility
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Facet selections are consistent, but selected implementation performs external IO under NoExternalIO.
expected: Early consistency can pass while behavioral assurance fails or remains unresolved.

cases.title: Cross-facet implication and cycle termination
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Finite rules contain a supported requirement chain and a cycle that adds no new facts.
expected: Reach a deterministic fixed point.
Do not invent a satisfying provider or assume unsupported negation from absence.

cases.title: Unsupported cross-facet search remains unresolved
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A constraint requires unsupported global disjunctive search or arbitrary predicate execution.
expected: Produce a residual obligation; no hidden solver-backed reconfiguration is claimed.

cases.title: Preserve unrelated exact-path structure
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A Theme modifier changes only an established palette path and advertises a matching frame.
expected: Establish supported preservation of disjoint unrelated structure.

cases.title: Unexpected unrelated write violates frame
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: The same modifier writes another component outside its declared change footprint.
expected: Contradict the frame claim with the write and target origin.

cases.title: Parent replacement affects descendants
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A modifier replaces a parent node but claims an old descendant is preserved.
expected: Do not infer descendant preservation merely because no direct leaf write occurred.

cases.title: Unknown or aliasing writes block frame proof
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A modifier uses an unknown native write or a may-alias path.
expected: Leave the affected frame obligation unresolved unless a valid footprint/disjointness witness exists.

cases.title: Facet independence does not imply commutation
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Two different-facet constructors or wrappers have order-sensitive effects.
expected: Preserve explicit order; do not sort or treat the applications as a set.

cases.title: Established special composition law is scoped
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A supported fixture establishes commutation or idempotence under explicit assumptions.
cases.action: Use the law inside and outside its scope.
expected: Permit only the established case; do not generalize to other meanings or arbitrary repetition.

cases.title: Provider interface success and failure
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: One configured provider satisfies a role; another shares operation names but lacks a required failure/protocol guarantee.
expected: Accept the supported conformance case under its evidence and reject/unresolve the second.
Names alone do not establish substitutability.

cases.title: Provider change invalidates dependent assurance
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A Backend provider changes while the role name remains the same.
expected: Invalidate affected conformance, effects, resources, cleanup, and downstream requirements.
Retain unrelated claims only where their dependencies/frame permit.

cases.title: Composite convenience preserves genuine equivalence
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A named convenience expands to a typed plan equivalent to an explicitly factored form.
cases.action: Compare elaborated order, occurrences, and obligations.
expected: Reuse valid semantics/assurance where equivalence is established, with both provenance chains.
Do not infer equivalence from facet labels alone.

cases.title: Multiword entry can denote one meaning
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An explicit typed lexical entry denotes a coherent domain idiom.
cases.action: Bind it under supported existing or fixture rules.
expected: Treat it as one meaning without forcing token-by-token decomposition or proper-noun status.

cases.title: Multiword versus compositional phrase ambiguity
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A phrase can denote a lexical entry or a compositional structure under a new policy with no precedence rule.
expected: Report ambiguity rather than silently enable longest-match recognition.
Track A retains existing documented grammar behavior.

cases.title: New overlapping import invalidates binding
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A cached unique selection receives a newly visible overlapping candidate.
expected: Revalidate; ambiguity is detected and old assurance is not attached to a stale choice.

cases.title: Candidate changes and negative dependencies
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A candidate is removed or its applicability changes; also test adding a previously absent matching name.
expected: Dependency tracking notices relevant candidate-set/absence changes, not just selected-body changes.

cases.title: Phrase, role, or policy change invalidates binding
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: The target role/type, phrase recognition, or resolution-policy version changes.
expected: Invalidate relevant binding results; reuse downstream summaries only after justified rebinding.

cases.title: No spelling-based prohibition or guarantee
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Equivalent test meanings use short, compound, aliased, and multiword names.
expected: No compound-word ban or automatic decomposition is applied.
Spelling does not create orthogonality or stronger assurance.

cases.title: Diagnostics expose exact target and candidates
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A binding ambiguity, exclusive-facet conflict, and wrapper frame violation are available.
expected: Show selected/competing meanings, actual role targets, requirements, and origins.
Do not invent unsupported qualification syntax or blame the caller automatically.

cases.title: Track A compatibility and Track B gating
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: Existing source is compiled before integration; a typed new-selector policy is also available.
cases.action: Run baseline mode and explicitly selected experimental integration if any.
expected: Default source semantics remain unchanged.
Reports identify the policy; no contracts command silently switches it.
Source-facing changes have separate grammar/regression activation gates.

cases.title: Inject allocation into a claimed clean body
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A positive no-allocation fixture is changed to include a modeled allocation.
cases.action: Apply the deliberate fault and exercise the checking/reporting boundary.
expected: The profile no longer establishes; the added event is in the explanation.

cases.title: Mutate before advertised unchanged failure
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A failure-preserving operation gains a mutation to the protected footprint before failure.
cases.action: Apply the deliberate fault and exercise the checking/reporting boundary.
expected: The outcome-specific frame/failure guarantee is rejected or refuted by the supported analysis.

cases.title: Smuggle IO through destructor
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A clean scope acquires a destructor performing modeled IO.
cases.action: Apply the deliberate fault and exercise the checking/reporting boundary.
expected: The closed-region no-IO guarantee cannot survive; body-only evidence is not promoted.

cases.title: Remove native approval witness
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: A previously approved native assumption loses its required valid witness.
cases.action: Apply the deliberate fault and exercise the checking/reporting boundary.
expected: Dependent effective assurance becomes unresolved under the same policy.

cases.title: Corrupt cache fingerprints
prerequisites: The relevant milestone implementation and a suitable local test harness.
cases.setup: An implementation, target, schema, or binding cache entry has a mismatched fingerprint.
cases.action: Apply the deliberate fault and exercise the checking/reporting boundary.
expected: Reject stale material and recompute or report unresolved; never retain stale success.

cases.title: Misspell or omit favorable metadata
